models._description: General Settings options (module_*/group_* installer toggles, company profile, report footer, multi-currency, KPI counters)
KPI Provider (AbstractModel; get_kpi_summary hook overridden by other modules)

behavioral_notes.element: res.config.settings module_* fields (module_auth_oauth, module_auth_ldap, module_voip, module_sms, module_google_calendar, module_base_import, module_partner_autocomplete, ...)
behavioral_notes.observation: base_setup declares ~16 module_* Boolean fields in res_config_settings.py. They store NO data: each is a deferred installer toggle. On save, res.config.settings.execute() (odoo/addons/base/models/res_config.py) classifies any module_<name> field via _get_classified_fields, then computes to_install = fields turned True whose ir.module.module.state != 'installed' and to_uninstall = fields turned False whose module is installed. to_install runs ir.module.module.button_immediate_install() at the END of the transaction (documented as MUST-be-last to avoid registry<->DB desync); to_uninstall opens the base.module.uninstall wizard. After install the env.transaction is reset and the web client reloads. This 'flip a Settings checkbox -> app installs' mechanism is invisible to ORM metadata.

group_multi_currency declares implied_group='base.group_multi_currency'. execute() -> set_values() classifies group_* fields and, when toggled True, calls groups._apply_group(implied_group) to add the implied group to base.group_user (all employees); when toggled False it calls groups._remove_group(implied_group). config_parameter fields persist instead: show_effect -> ir.config_parameter 'base_setup.show_effect', profiling_enabled_until -> 'base.profiling_enabled_until'. So a single save mutates security groups AND system parameters AND module install state at once, none of which is a stored field on this TransientModel.

The 'Invite users by email' onboarding action. It normalizes each email via tools.mail.parse_contact_from_email, requires the Discuss app (raises UserError if the email_normalized field is absent), REACTIVATES any matching deactivated users (active=True) before creating new ones, de-dupes against already-handled normalized emails, then create()s each new user under signup_valid context so signup tokens are issued. The reactivation + signup-token side-effect chain lives only in code.

behavioral_notes.element: res.config.settings company/profile setup actions + computed counters
behavioral_notes.observation: open_company() returns an act_window onto the current res.company form; open_new_user_default_groups() lazily creates/refs base.default_user_group (a res.groups + ir.model.data pair) and opens it; edit_external_header() jumps to the company external report-layout QWeb view. company_count/active_user_count/language_count/company_informations are @api.depends('company_id') computes (must depend on a field because this is a TransientModel) running sudo search_count over res.company / non-share res.users / res.lang to drive the Settings dashboard tiles. report_footer and company_name are related writes back onto res.company.

The Settings 'users' tile is fed by /base_setup/data, gated on base.group_erp_manager, which runs raw SQL over res_users/res_users_log to count active non-share users and 'pending' users (those with no res_users_log row, i.e. never logged in) and returns an _action_show() to chase them. Frontend: static/src/views/module_views.js registers ResetModuleStateCogMenu in the 'cogMenu' registry; on the ir.module.module list view it calls ir.module.module.button_reset_state and reloads -- a recovery tool for installs left in a transient state.

it_architecture.application: base_setup (General Settings foundation: base res.config.settings option registry, apps/users onboarding, company setup) -- auto_install support add-on over base + web
information_flows: save Settings: res.config.settings.execute() -> set_values() (groups via _apply_group/_remove_group, ir.default, ir.config_parameter) -> module_* install via ir.module.module.button_immediate_install() at end of txn -> env.transaction.reset() -> web client reload
uninstall toggle: module_* set False -> base.module.uninstall wizard
invite users: res.users.web_create_users(emails) -> reactivate deactivated + create(signup_valid) -> signup tokens
dashboard: /base_setup/data raw SQL over res_users/res_users_log -> active/pending counts; computed company_count/active_user_count/language_count over res.company/res.users/res.lang
kpi: kpi.provider.get_kpi_summary() overridden by downstream modules, surfaced via /kpi/summary
frontend_components: ResetModuleStateCogMenu (cogMenu registry entry on ir.module.module list view -> button_reset_state)

capabilities: Configure the System via General Settings (option registry)
Enable/Disable Features by Installing/Uninstalling Apps (module_* toggles)
Toggle Security-Group Feature Flags (group_* implied groups, e.g. multi-currency)
Set Up the Company Profile, Report Layout & Footer

value_streams: Configure-to-Activate: admin toggles a Settings option -> execute() -> module install / group apply / config param -> reloaded client with the feature live
Invite-to-Active-User: enter emails -> web_create_users -> reactivate/create + signup token -> onboarded user
policies: execute() restricted to admins (env.is_admin else AccessError)
group_* toggles mutate base.group_user implied groups (firm-wide feature entitlement)
module install/uninstall MUST run at end of transaction to avoid registry<->DB desync
stakeholders: System administrator / ERP manager (owns General Settings, app install, user invite)
End user (inherits feature flags and company defaults set here)
Module developer (extends res.config.settings with module_*/group_*/config_* fields and kpi.provider)
metrics: pending users count (invited but never logged in, via /base_setup/data)
kpi.provider.get_kpi_summary aggregates (surfaced to the databases list)

classification.rationale: base_setup is cross-cutting firm IT infrastructure (Porter support activity; Stabell & Fjeldstad 'support'), not a value-creating primary activity of any chain/shop/network. It is the foundation of Odoo's General Settings: the base res.config.settings option registry plus apps/users onboarding and company setup. auto_install=true makes it ubiquitous configuration plumbing every deployment relies on. Its substance is behavioral, not data: ~16 module_* installer toggles that drive ir.module.module.button_immediate_install on save, group_* feature flags that mutate security groups, config_parameter writes, the invite-users flow and dashboard counters -- the only declared model (abstract kpi.provider) bears no rows. APQC 8.0 'Manage Information Technology' fits because the work here is IT delivery/configuration management: provision and manage application capabilities (install apps), manage IT configuration (parameters, feature flags), administer user/company setup. 13.0 'Develop and Manage Business Capabilities' was considered (settings govern which capabilities are on) but rejected: base_setup is a concrete running configuration/installer mechanism, not a governance/portfolio capability -- its work is squarely IT delivery, i.e. 8.0.

standard_capabilities: General Settings page with grouped option toggles (the res.config.settings framework)
Install/uninstall apps by flipping a module_* checkbox (deferred immediate install at end of txn)
Feature flags via group_* implied-group toggles (e.g. multi-currency)
System parameters via config_parameter fields (show_effect, profiling window)
Company profile, report layout and report footer setup
Invite users by email with reactivation and signup tokens (web_create_users)
Setup dashboard counters (active users, companies, languages, pending users) and KPI provider hook
Reset-module-state recovery cog menu on the Apps list
typical_fits: Turning on optional integrations (OAuth/LDAP/SMS/VoIP/Google Calendar) from Settings without manual app install
Enabling multi-currency or other group-based features firm-wide via a single toggle
Standing up a new company profile and branded report layout/footer
Bulk-inviting the initial user set during onboarding
common_gaps: Adding a new Settings option requires JS/Python dev (declare a module_*/group_*/config_* field + view) -- not configurable from UI
Module install/uninstall side-effects (data migration, dependency chains) are not previewed before save
No granular per-user feature flags here (group_* toggles apply to base.group_user firm-wide)
KPI provider returns [] until downstream modules override get_kpi_summary
No external integrations in base_setup itself (gap #7: zero outbound HTTP/SDK call sites)
